title: Where should the next sample go?
hook: Where should the next sample go? Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Refine quadrature only on intervals whose coarse and split estimates disagree too much.

misconception: Uniformly adding the same number of samples everywhere is necessary for an accuracy target.
objective: Refine quadrature only on intervals whose coarse and split estimates disagree too much.

claims.text: The coarse and split estimates supply a local error estimate. Only disagreement above tolerance triggers deeper refinement; the linear contrast needs none, while the additional sharper case concentrates work where agreement is weaker.
